statement: The US Senate confirms Todd Blanche as Attorney General by recorded roll call vote between 2026-08-07 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Congress.gov or senate.gov roll call record shows a Senate vote confirming Todd Blanche as United States Attorney General with a vote date between 2026-08-07 and 2026-09-30.
failure_condition: The Senate holds no confirming vote on Blanche on or before 2026-09-30, whether through withdrawal of the nomination, failed cloture, or the vote never being scheduled.

statement: The Russia sanctions bill passed by the US Senate on 2026-08-07 is enacted into US public law between 2026-08-07 and 2026-11-06.
resolution: Congress.gov status for the Russia sanctions measure passed by the Senate on 2026-08-07 shows Became Public Law with an enactment date on or before 2026-11-06.
failure_condition: The measure is not enacted by 2026-11-06 because the House does not pass it, the President does not sign it, or no veto override occurs by that date.

statement: Houthi forces take control of Marib city, Yemen, between 2026-08-08 and 2027-01-15.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, or Al Jazeera report Marib city under Houthi control, or the Yemeni government concedes its loss, with event dates inside the window.
failure_condition: Marib city remains under Yemeni government control through 2027-01-15, with no Houthi capture of the city occurring in the window.

statement: The Colombian government or the ELN publicly and formally declares the bilateral peace process or ceasefire suspended or ended between 2026-08-08 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, or El Tiempo report an official Colombian government or ELN statement dated within the window declaring the peace process or ceasefire suspended or terminated.
failure_condition: Neither party issues a formal statement ending or suspending the process within the window and the process nominally continues through 2026-11-30.

statement: Front-month WTI crude futures settle at or above 95.00 USD per barrel on at least one NYMEX trading day between 2026-08-10 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Official CME NYMEX daily settlement for front-month WTI crude is at or above 95.00 USD on at least one trading day between 2026-08-10 and 2026-11-30, per CME or EIA records.
failure_condition: Every front-month WTI daily settlement in the window is below 95.00 USD.

statement: The FOMC lowers the federal funds target range at its scheduled September 2026 meeting.
resolution: The FOMC statement on federalreserve.gov concluding the scheduled September 2026 meeting announces a federal funds target range lower than the range in effect immediately before that meeting.
failure_condition: The September 2026 FOMC statement holds or raises the target range, or the scheduled meeting does not take place.

statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least 8 CVE entries with dateAdded values between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-04.
resolution: The public CISA KEV JSON feed contains at least 8 entries whose dateAdded field falls between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-04 inclusive.
failure_condition: Fewer than 8 KEV entries carry a dateAdded value inside the window.

statement: A vulnerability in Claude Code or Gemini CLI disclosed in early August 2026 is added to the CISA KEV catalog with a dateAdded between 2026-08-08 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: The CISA KEV JSON feed lists a CVE whose product or description names Claude Code or Gemini CLI, with dateAdded between 2026-08-08 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming Claude Code or Gemini CLI carries a dateAdded value within the window.

statement: Meta files an appeal or notice of appeal of the 567 million USD New Mexico child-safety judgment between 2026-08-08 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Court docket shows a Meta notice of appeal in the New Mexico 567 million USD child-safety case, or two of Reuters, AP, Bloomberg report the filing, dated within the window.
failure_condition: Meta makes no appellate filing in the window, including because it settles, pays, or obtains post-trial relief that removes the judgment before any appeal is filed.

statement: GDACS raises tropical cyclone CHAN-HOM-26 to Orange or Red alert level between 2026-08-08 and 2026-08-21.
resolution: The GDACS event record for tropical cyclone CHAN-HOM-26, event id 1001299, shows an Orange or Red alert episode dated between 2026-08-08 and 2026-08-21.
failure_condition: CHAN-HOM-26 remains at Green alert for all GDACS episodes dated in the window or dissipates without an Orange or Red episode.
